aiDocuments.title: Ward 12 Sanitation SOP
aiDocuments.content: All complaints related to missed pickups, overflow and mixed waste in Ward 12 must be routed to the Ward 12 Sanitation Department within 2 hours.

aiDocuments.title: Segregation Guidelines
aiDocuments.content: Households must separate organic, recyclable, hazardous, medical, ewaste and general waste. Recyclable waste should be cleaned and dry before disposal.

aiDocuments.title: Complaint Escalation Rules
aiDocuments.content: Unresolved high-priority complaints escalate automatically after 24 hours to the supervisor and then to the municipal control room after 48 hours.
